mfy.review:
4. 312 onk pora ei course tae Mfy Sir matha ultae diben r lab o bhaloi tricky
5. 362 easiest in the list of courses given by you. Hzr Sir r kache korle uni exactly same question koren every year numbers o change korena assignments o same thake. Bhalo na korle skill issue honestly, Sir khali theory poran but exam e khali math den maths gula onk lengthy porikha r ager raat pore exam deyar course na but easiest. Lab onk shoja Mehrab bhaiya ke instructor hishabe paile apnar jibon set. Try taking under Hzr kichu na shikhleo grade ta paben but Sir curve monehoi korenna cause onkei full marks pai.
